Arcade piers contact the base, arches have visible soffit depth, and the continuous porch has a clear route to the entry. The remaining right-bay table does not obstruct the entry route.
Glass close shows physical jambs, head, sill, shutter blades, frame and optical pane with interior depth. The arched entry detail separately proves fanlight/frame registration.
